one-line thesis: Fast-growing Vadodara power-T&D EPC (FY26 consol revenue **₹533 cr**, ~**16x** since its 2022 NSE-Emerge IPO; PAT **₹53.5 cr** ~10%) that just graduated to the **NSE main board (02-Jun-2026)** and is now pivoting to **"Viviana 2.0" — a vertically-integrated power-infra player**: a ₹100 cr greenfield **power-transformer plant** (10 MVA now → 500 MVA/400 kV by FY30), **build-own BESS** (Rajasthan RVUNL + Gujarat GUVNL) explicitly to clear the technical/asset pre-qualification for large central **TBCB / Ministry-of-Power** tenders, plus an asset-light **real-estate arm (Life Spaces)** whose sole purpose is to throw off *hard collateral* so the EPC book can scale to ₹2,000–2,500 cr without pledging promoter equity. **FY27 guidance is deliberately muted — revenue >₹900 cr at the *same* PAT (margin steps down to 8.5–9.5%)** — on a >₹1,000 cr order book + >₹1,500 cr of live bids.
financial scorecard (fy26 consolidated):
| Metric | FY26 | YoY | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue (consol) | **₹533 cr** | ~16x since FY22 IPO | ~₹250 cr of it invoiced in Mar-26 alone |
| PAT | **₹53.46 cr** | — | ~10% PAT margin ("operating leverage functioning at max efficiency") |
| H2 margins | ↓ sharply | — | gross & EBITDA moderated on **raw-material price hikes** (metal inflation) |
| Order book | **>₹1,000 cr** | — | ~1.9x FY26 revenue |
| Debtors | ~₹300–336 cr | ↑ | >60% (60–70%) collected by end-May-26; rise attributed to heavy Q4/March execution |
| Cash | **₹73.63 cr** (incl. non-fund-based limit) | — | running ~15% headroom on banking facilities |
| Debt instruments | NCD **₹45 cr @ 12%** | — | interest already baked into FY27 PAT guide |
| Leverage target | **D/E 1.2–1.5x** long-term | — | through the manufacturing capex build |
> ⚠️ EBITDA / segmental margins not given numerically on the call; H2 margin compression flagged qualitatively (RM inflation, largely recovered via price-variation clause). Revenue quoted as ₹533 cr by mgmt; one analyst referenced ₹502 cr — treat ₹533 cr (CFO-stated) as the figure.
guidance (critical — verify next quarter:
- **FY27 consolidated revenue: >₹900 cr**, targeting the **same PAT (~₹53 cr)** → i.e. margin compression is guided, not growth in profit.
- **FY27 PAT margin: 8.5–9.5%** (per PPT); mgmt widened to **8.5–10%** verbally, "majorly varies with geopolitical situation / force majeure." (Down from an earlier ~10% guide.)
- **Raw material: 90–95% of the order book carries a price-variation (pass-through) clause** → residual risk is *availability*, not price.
- **Life Spaces FY27 revenue: ₹125–150 cr** (property sales, not rental).
- **Order carry-forward: >₹700–800 cr** of orders to be carried into FY28 after executing the current book.
- **Transformer division long-term:** ₹400–600 cr standalone revenue by **FY30**; power-equipment division ₹1,000–1,200 cr segment revenue at full utilisation by **FY32**, at **9–10% PAT margin**.
- **Life Spaces asset base:** ₹100+ cr of debt-free commercial-asset collateral by **FY30**; ₹6–8 cr/yr steady-state rental annuity.
order book & pipeline:
- **Order book >₹1,000 cr** (~1.9x FY26 rev). Split (per mgmt): **EPC ~₹540 cr**, **+~₹240 cr** where Viviana is **L1** (to be announced on LOI/LOI), remainder is **BESS**.
- **Live bids: >₹1,500 cr** submitted — "expecting considerable orders."
- Normal EPC project cycle **6–24 months** (drives the order-book-to-revenue lag).
- **Gujarat utility 3,000-transformer order:** ~**1,900+ transformers already manufactured & supplied**.
- Customers: state utilities (RVUNL, GUVNL, Gujarat DISCOMs), IPPs, renewable developers, industrial clients.
segment / subsidiary detail:
| Vertical | What | FY26 / status |
|---|---|---|
| **Power T&D EPC (core)** | EHV substations + transmission lines up to **400 kV** | the ₹533 cr engine; ~₹540 cr EPC order book |
| **Transformer manufacturing (new)** | greenfield, Bhavin Parekh-led; power transformers for utilities, BESS, wind, solar, data centres | ₹100 cr / 14 acres near Vadodara (see §8) |
| **BESS (build-own)** | Rajasthan RVUNL + Gujarat GUVNL grid-scale storage | pre-qualification play for TBCB tenders (see §6/§8) |
| **Viviana Life Spaces (90% sub)** | real-estate **development** on a joint-development model — corporate + residential "walk-to-work" | 2 Vadodara projects, ₹370 cr GDV; >₹350–360 cr revenue over ~2 yrs |
growth verticals / optionality:
- **Transformer up-the-value-chain:** starts at 10 MVA (Jul-26), climbs to **500 MVA / 400 kV by FY30**, then adds **reactors and furnace transformers**. Cites a 2-decade domestic demand runway ("thereafter it's replacement") + **UL certification (by FY27-end) to sell into US & Canada** = export optionality.
- **BESS as a tender key, not just an asset:** mgmt is explicit that BESS is the **"calculated strategic gateway"** to clear the technical-operating-credential + asset-ownership pre-qualification the central ministry requires — unlocking **multi-thousand-crore TBCB / MoP tenders at higher EBITDA**. Once the BESS portfolio is operational (FY27), it re-rates their tender eligibility.
- **Life Spaces = a financing tool, not a property bet:** deliberately capital-light; Viviana acts as *developer* and keeps **15–20% of the built asset as hard collateral** (does not buy land/assets with EPC funds), targeting ₹100+ cr debt-free collateral by FY30 so it can support a ₹2,000–2,500 cr EPC book without pledging promoter equity or manufacturing plants.
- **Data-centre / renewables pull:** new transformers positioned as general-purpose for power sector but usable in **data centres, wind, solar, BESS**.
margins & cost dynamics:
- H2 FY26 gross/EBITDA margins moderated on **metal price inflation** (RM hikes).
- Structural mitigant: **90–95% of orders have a price-variation clause** → cost is pass-through; residual worry is *material availability*.
- FY27 PAT margin steps **down to 8.5–9.5%** (from ~10%) — mix shift + geopolitics/force-majeure buffer; ₹45 cr NCD at 12% interest is inside the number.
- Manufacturing integration is pitched as the **margin-up lever** ("capture higher margins and control over supply chain") — long-dated (transformer div targeted at 9–10% PAT by FY32).
capex / expansion (watch slippage):
- **Greenfield power-transformer plant near Vadodara** — **₹100 cr** approved capex (first phase **₹70–80 cr**), **14 acres**, Bhavin Parekh-led; funded via **internal accruals + structured arrangements** (no equity dilution stated); scrutinising state industrial-policy incentives.
  - **Existing facility** starts production **~end-Jul-2026**, transformers up to **10 MVA**.
  - **By FY27-end:** type-testing up to **18.5 MVA**; **UL certification** for US/Canada.
  - **By FY28-end:** manufacture up to **63 MVA / 132 kV**.
  - **By FY30:** manufacture up to **500 MVA / 400 kV**; then add reactors + furnace transformers.
  - **Testing capacity: ~2,000 MVA this FY → 5,000 MVA next FY.**
- **BESS – Rajasthan (RVUNL):** total capex **₹198 cr**; individual sanctions from **Indian Overseas Bank + Canara Bank**; **financial closure expected "next week"** (pending Jodhpur revenue-dept final allotment). No BESS revenue in FY27; **major BESS capex falls in FY27**.
- **BESS – Gujarat (GUVNL):** **BESPA signed**; **1,10,000 sq ft** adjacent to a pooling substation in Vadodara (land identified, via revenue dept).
- **BESS unit economics (analyst-framed, mgmt confirmed):** ~₹300 cr investment (₹60 cr equity / ₹60 cr subsidy / ₹180 cr debt), ~₹40 cr/yr revenue, ~₹17–18 cr interest → **cash PBT ~₹14 cr**; IRR **single-digit today**, expected to improve as **lithium prices correct**.
- **Life Spaces:** 2 Vadodara projects, **₹370 cr GDV** — tallest corporate project + first platinum-green building in Vadodara (Gotri); funded by **debt + investors** (10% investor stake); construction loans repaid once project is **70% sold**.
capital allocation:
- **No promoter-equity pledge / no core-plant encumbrance** — the entire Life Spaces rationale is to generate hard collateral *instead of* pledging, and to relieve working capital that is **90–95% tied up as cash collateral** at the bank.
- Manufacturing capex funded by internal accruals + structured arrangements; leverage held to **D/E 1.2–1.5x**.
- **Fund-raise / equity dilution:** asked directly — mgmt said "we are just working out… not appropriate to speak today," i.e. **an equity raise is live but unconfirmed** (watch-item).
- ₹45 cr NCD at 12% already on the books.
risks & watch-items:
- **Guidance is flat-profit:** FY27 revenue +~70% but PAT held flat → **margin compression is the story**; verify the 8.5–9.5% print.
- **Working-capital / receivables stress:** debtor days rising; ~₹300 cr debtors, only 60–70% collected; heavy March-loaded revenue; relies on continuous state-utility recovery to fund creditors.
- **Real-estate diversification** for an EPC/engineering company drew repeated analyst pushback ("what's Viviana's role if you don't invest capital?") — execution & governance optics to monitor.
- **Greenfield transformer plant = execution + certification risk** (10→500 MVA ramp, UL cert, type-testing milestones can slip).
- **BESS single-digit IRR** today; economics hinge on lithium price correction + tender wins.
- **State-utility / geographic concentration** (Gujarat, Rajasthan; ~3,000-transformer Gujarat order).
- **Possible equity dilution** ("working out"); ₹45 cr NCD at 12% is expensive.
- **Material availability** (not price) is the residual RM risk despite pass-through clauses.
management quality / tone:
- **Choksi-family promoter team**; notably candid and specific on structure and risks (Richi Choksi fielded nearly all Q&A). Fast institutional graduation: **NSE Emerge (Sep-2022) → NSE main board (02-Jun-2026)** in <4 years, ~16x revenue.
- Tone is **promotional/ambitious** ("astronomical growth," "Viviana 2.0," "exponentially well-positioned") — discount the adjectives; the substance (transformer ramp, BESS-for-tender-qualification, collateral-vehicle logic) is coherent.
- Willing to give **explicit, falsifiable milestones** (MVA/kV by year, capex splits, MVA testing capacity, BESS cash-PBT math) — good for tracking.
- Added a **32-yr transformer veteran (Bhavin Parekh)** to run manufacturing — signals seriousness on the new vertical.
non-obvious takeaways:
- **The order book is the wrong lens for FY27** — despite >₹1,000 cr OB + >₹1,500 cr bids, mgmt guides revenue *down-shifted vs order cover* and **PAT flat**; the real FY27–28 driver is *carrying ₹700–800 cr into FY28* and lifting margin via manufacturing much later (FY30–32).
- **BESS is a means, not an end:** its stated ROI is single-digit — the payoff is **pre-qualification credentials** that open large central TBCB/MoP tenders. Model the *option value on the tender pipeline*, not the BESS asset IRR.
- **Life Spaces is corporate finance dressed as real estate** — the KPI is *collateral generated* (₹100+ cr by FY30, ₹6–8 cr rental annuity to offset WC interest), not property profit. Judge it on whether it actually de-stresses the EPC working-capital cycle.
- Margin is a **pass-through model** (90–95% price-variation clauses) — so the H2 hit was timing/lag, and the FY27 8.5–9.5% guide is a *mix/structural* step-down, not a commodity spike.

themes.title: Power transmission & renewable-evacuation capex
themes.need: Grid build-out to evacuate ~90 GW of new renewables is the broadest theme in the universe - pulling EHV/765kV transmission EPC, towers, conductors, OPGW, cables and HVDC. POWERGRID/ADANIENSOL TBCB pipeline plus state RDSS/underground-cabling capex (Rajesh Power 544291, OMPOWER) underpins multi-year visibility for EPC, tower (KP Green 544150, SKIPPER) and conductor/cable makers (KEI, RRKABEL, DYCL).
themes.driver: Fresh TBCB awards + execution ramp; EPC order inflows over next 1-2 quarters.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Engaged in Power Transmission, Distribution and Industrial Electrical EPC projects, covering supply, erection, testing and commissioning of transmission lines, EHV substations and distribution networks, underground cable laying, and upgradation/modernisation of existing power systems.
- Executed projects include 400/220/132/66/33 KV transmission lines and substations for government utilities, private power entities and industries; customers include state power utilities, private power entities and renewable energy developers, won through open bidding as well as preferential contracts.
- Deck cites 11+ years experience, 80+ completed projects, 100+ professionals and a ~500+ committed workforce, with ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and OHSAS 45001:2018 certifications.
- Management frames the restructuring as 'Viviana Power Tech is not becoming smaller. It is becoming more focused.'
- Milestone slide records migration to the Main Board in 2026, after listing on the NSE Emerge platform in 2022.

segment_detail.title: Segment / subsidiary detail
segment_detail.body:
| Vertical | What | FY26 / status |
|---|---|---|
| **Power T&D EPC (core)** | EHV substations + transmission lines up to **400 kV** | the ₹533 cr engine; ~₹540 cr EPC order book |
| **Transformer manufacturing (new)** | greenfield, Bhavin Parekh-led; power transformers for utilities, BESS, wind, solar, data centres | ₹100 cr / 14 acres near Vadodara (see §8) |
| **BESS (build-own)** | Rajasthan RVUNL + Gujarat GUVNL grid-scale storage | pre-qualification play for TBCB tenders (see §6/§8) |
| **Viviana Life Spaces (90% sub)** | real-estate **development** on a joint-development model — corporate + residential "walk-to-work" | 2 Vadodara projects, ₹370 cr GDV; >₹350–360 cr revenue over ~2 yrs |

order_book.title: Order book & pipeline
order_book.body:
- **Order book >₹1,000 cr** (~1.9x FY26 rev). Split (per mgmt): **EPC ~₹540 cr**, **+~₹240 cr** where Viviana is **L1** (to be announced on LOI/LOI), remainder is **BESS**.
- **Live bids: >₹1,500 cr** submitted — "expecting considerable orders."
- Normal EPC project cycle **6–24 months** (drives the order-book-to-revenue lag).
- **Gujarat utility 3,000-transformer order:** ~**1,900+ transformers already manufactured & supplied**.
- Customers: state utilities (RVUNL, GUVNL, Gujarat DISCOMs), IPPs, renewable developers, industrial clients.

guidance.title: Guidance (CRITICAL — verify next quarter)
guidance.body:
- **FY27 consolidated revenue: >₹900 cr**, targeting the **same PAT (~₹53 cr)** → i.e. margin compression is guided, not growth in profit.
- **FY27 PAT margin: 8.5–9.5%** (per PPT); mgmt widened to **8.5–10%** verbally, "majorly varies with geopolitical situation / force majeure." (Down from an earlier ~10% guide.)
- **Raw material: 90–95% of the order book carries a price-variation (pass-through) clause** → residual risk is *availability*, not price.
- **Life Spaces FY27 revenue: ₹125–150 cr** (property sales, not rental).
- **Order carry-forward: >₹700–800 cr** of orders to be carried into FY28 after executing the current book.
- **Transformer division long-term:** ₹400–600 cr standalone revenue by **FY30**; power-equipment division ₹1,000–1,200 cr segment revenue at full utilisation by **FY32**, at **9–10% PAT margin**.
- **Life Spaces asset base:** ₹100+ cr of debt-free commercial-asset collateral by **FY30**; ₹6–8 cr/yr steady-state rental annuity.

growth_optionality.title: Growth verticals / optionality
growth_optionality.body:
- **Transformer up-the-value-chain:** starts at 10 MVA (Jul-26), climbs to **500 MVA / 400 kV by FY30**, then adds **reactors and furnace transformers**. Cites a 2-decade domestic demand runway ("thereafter it's replacement") + **UL certification (by FY27-end) to sell into US & Canada** = export optionality.
- **BESS as a tender key, not just an asset:** mgmt is explicit that BESS is the **"calculated strategic gateway"** to clear the technical-operating-credential + asset-ownership pre-qualification the central ministry requires — unlocking **multi-thousand-crore TBCB / MoP tenders at higher EBITDA**. Once the BESS portfolio is operational (FY27), it re-rates their tender eligibility.
- **Life Spaces = a financing tool, not a property bet:** deliberately capital-light; Viviana acts as *developer* and keeps **15–20% of the built asset as hard collateral** (does not buy land/assets with EPC funds), targeting ₹100+ cr debt-free collateral by FY30 so it can support a ₹2,000–2,500 cr EPC book without pledging promoter equity or manufacturing plants.
- **Data-centre / renewables pull:** new transformers positioned as general-purpose for power sector but usable in **data centres, wind, solar, BESS**.

margins.title: Margins & cost dynamics
margins.body:
- H2 FY26 gross/EBITDA margins moderated on **metal price inflation** (RM hikes).
- Structural mitigant: **90–95% of orders have a price-variation clause** → cost is pass-through; residual worry is *material availability*.
- FY27 PAT margin steps **down to 8.5–9.5%** (from ~10%) — mix shift + geopolitics/force-majeure buffer; ₹45 cr NCD at 12% interest is inside the number.
- Manufacturing integration is pitched as the **margin-up lever** ("capture higher margins and control over supply chain") — long-dated (transformer div targeted at 9–10% PAT by FY32).

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- **No promoter-equity pledge / no core-plant encumbrance** — the entire Life Spaces rationale is to generate hard collateral *instead of* pledging, and to relieve working capital that is **90–95% tied up as cash collateral** at the bank.
- Manufacturing capex funded by internal accruals + structured arrangements; leverage held to **D/E 1.2–1.5x**.
- **Fund-raise / equity dilution:** asked directly — mgmt said "we are just working out… not appropriate to speak today," i.e. **an equity raise is live but unconfirmed** (watch-item).
- ₹45 cr NCD at 12% already on the books.

management_tone.title: Management quality / tone
management_tone.body:
- **Choksi-family promoter team**; notably candid and specific on structure and risks (Richi Choksi fielded nearly all Q&A). Fast institutional graduation: **NSE Emerge (Sep-2022) → NSE main board (02-Jun-2026)** in <4 years, ~16x revenue.
- Tone is **promotional/ambitious** ("astronomical growth," "Viviana 2.0," "exponentially well-positioned") — discount the adjectives; the substance (transformer ramp, BESS-for-tender-qualification, collateral-vehicle logic) is coherent.
- Willing to give **explicit, falsifiable milestones** (MVA/kV by year, capex splits, MVA testing capacity, BESS cash-PBT math) — good for tracking.
- Added a **32-yr transformer veteran (Bhavin Parekh)** to run manufacturing — signals seriousness on the new vertical.

risks.title: Risks & watch-items
risks.body:
- **Guidance is flat-profit:** FY27 revenue +~70% but PAT held flat → **margin compression is the story**; verify the 8.5–9.5% print.
- **Working-capital / receivables stress:** debtor days rising; ~₹300 cr debtors, only 60–70% collected; heavy March-loaded revenue; relies on continuous state-utility recovery to fund creditors.
- **Real-estate diversification** for an EPC/engineering company drew repeated analyst pushback ("what's Viviana's role if you don't invest capital?") — execution & governance optics to monitor.
- **Greenfield transformer plant = execution + certification risk** (10→500 MVA ramp, UL cert, type-testing milestones can slip).
- **BESS single-digit IRR** today; economics hinge on lithium price correction + tender wins.
- **State-utility / geographic concentration** (Gujarat, Rajasthan; ~3,000-transformer Gujarat order).
- **Possible equity dilution** ("working out"); ₹45 cr NCD at 12% is expensive.
- **Material availability** (not price) is the residual RM risk despite pass-through clauses.

non_obvious.title: Non-obvious takeaways
non_obvious.body:
- **The order book is the wrong lens for FY27** — despite >₹1,000 cr OB + >₹1,500 cr bids, mgmt guides revenue *down-shifted vs order cover* and **PAT flat**; the real FY27–28 driver is *carrying ₹700–800 cr into FY28* and lifting margin via manufacturing much later (FY30–32).
- **BESS is a means, not an end:** its stated ROI is single-digit — the payoff is **pre-qualification credentials** that open large central TBCB/MoP tenders. Model the *option value on the tender pipeline*, not the BESS asset IRR.
- **Life Spaces is corporate finance dressed as real estate** — the KPI is *collateral generated* (₹100+ cr by FY30, ₹6–8 cr rental annuity to offset WC interest), not property profit. Judge it on whether it actually de-stresses the EPC working-capital cycle.
- Margin is a **pass-through model** (90–95% price-variation clauses) — so the H2 hit was timing/lag, and the FY27 8.5–9.5% guide is a *mix/structural* step-down, not a commodity spike.

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Divestment] The disinvestment is explicitly framed as allowing the Company to concentrate entirely on the core power infrastructure business, including EPC, T&D, power transformer manufacturing, renewable energy integration and BESS.
- [Industry] Deck cites Rs.9.2 tn of transmission capex anticipated in India between FY25-32E, split Inter-State Rs.6.6 tn and Intra-State Rs.2.7 tn (source: National Electricity Plan and CEA).
- [Industry] T&D outlook table: transmission line length 5.07 Lakhs CKm (Mar-26) to 6.48 Lakhs CKm (2032E); transformation capacity 1,451 GVA to 2,342 GVA; peak electricity demand 238 GW to 458 GW; inter-regional transmission capacity 120 GW to 168 GW.
- [Industry] Deck states All India AT&C losses declined to 15% in FY25.
- [Leadership] Chairman & Managing Director Mr. Nikesh Kishorchandra Choksi has 40+ years in the power sector including GETCO (21+ years), Torrent Power (3 years) and Adani Transmission (8+ years); a dedicated Head - Power Transformer Business (Mr. Bhavin Parikh, 32+ years, ex-Transformers & Rectifiers, Electrotherm, IMP Powers, Shilchar) was brought in for the new vertical.
